import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { region } from "./region";
import { employees } from "./employees";

export const territories = defineTable("territories", {
    columns: {
        territoryId: col.varchar({ length: 20 }).primaryKey(),
        territoryDescription: col.varchar({ length: 60 }).notNull(),
        regionId: col.smallint().notNull()
    },
    relations: {
        region: rel.belongsTo(() => region, { onDelete: "no action" }),
        employees: rel.manyToMany(() => employees, { through: "employee_territories" })
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
